summary: AcmeDocs template engine allows expression injection via X-Template-Hint header
description:
AcmeDocs evaluates expressions supplied in the `X-Template-Hint` request header when the preview feature is enabled. This can lead to remote code execution (CVE-2099-12345).

### Patches
Fixed in AcmeDocs 4.2.4.

### Workarounds
Disable the preview feature.
